title: Implicit-layer / DEQ gradient as resolvent of (I - D_z f) via the implicit function theorem
expression_sketch:
Fixed-point layer: z_star = f(z_star, x) with f : U -> C^d (or R^d) C^1 near (z_star, x). Set g(z, x) = f(z, x) - z. Then g(z_star, x) = 0. If D_z g(z_star, x) = D_z f - I is invertible,
  D_x z_star = (I - D_z f(z_star, x))**(-1) * D_x f(z_star, x).
Bai-Kolter-Koltun Thm 1 (loss form): with g = f - id,
  d ell / d(·) = - (d ell / d z_star) * (J_g(z_star))**(-1) * (d f / d(·)).
Since J_g = J_f - I this is the same resolvent (I - J_f)**(-1).
Neumann member (when spectral radius of J_f < 1):
  (I - J_f)**(-1) = Sum_{k=0}^oo J_f**k,
so D_x z_star = (I + J_f + J_f**2 + ...) D_x f, the infinite unrolled chain rule of weight-tied residual iteration.
Scalar C^1 probe (SymPy):
  z = tanh(w*z + x),   1 - w*sech(w*z+x)**2 != 0,
  dz/dx = sech(w*z+x)**2 / (1 - w*sech(w*z+x)**2).
latent_structure: The infinite unrolled Jacobian series of a weight-tied layer is the Neumann series for a single resolvent R(1; D_z f) = (I - J_f)^{-1}. Master object: that resolvent (equivalently J_g^{-1} with g = f - id). Two members: IFT closed form, and geometric series of Jacobians. This is autodiff through an implicit layer, not a fitted network.

function_domains.f: C^1 on an open neighborhood U of (z_star, x) in R^d x R^p (or C)
function_domains.tanh: entire (as a holomorphic map C->C); real-analytic on R

nonzero_conditions.statement: D_z g(z_star, x) = D_z f(z_star, x) - I is invertible (Bai et al. Thm 1; IFT nondegeneracy)
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

nonzero_conditions.statement: Scalar probe: 1 - w*sech(w*z+x)**2 != 0 at the root
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

analytic_domains.statement: f is C^1 on an open neighborhood of the equilibrium (z_star, x); the IFT then yields a unique C^1 local solution z(x)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

analytic_domains.statement: Neumann series member additionally requires spectral radius of D_z f(z_star, x) strictly less than 1
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

branch_conventions: Real IFT in the DEQ paper; the scalar tanh probe is the real restriction of an entire function.
The inverse (I-J)^{-1} is the resolvent at 1, not a principal logarithm.

limit_domains.statement: Neumann series is the limit of partial sums Sum_{k=0}^N J^k as N->oo in operator norm, under rho(J)<1
limit_domains.label: DECLARED
limit_domains.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

source_provenance: Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser, 2002

derived_conditions.statement: g = f - id implies -J_g^{-1} = (I - J_f)^{-1} when either inverse exists
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Bai, Kolter and Koltun, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1909.01377v2, Theorem 1 and Appendix A; Krantz and Parks, The Implicit Function Theorem, Birkhauser 2002

derived_conditions.statement: rho(J_f)<1 implies I-J_f is invertible and the Neumann series equals the resolvent
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

why_not_cse_lgg: Unrolled Jacobians J, J^2, J^3, ... look like a chain of distinct products. CSE will not sum them to (I-J)^{-1}. LGG will not invent the IFT resolvent. The compact representation is one inverse Jacobian at equilibrium, independent of the forward root finder.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide: DEQ, implicit function theorem, resolvent, Neumann, equilibrium, fixed point, Bai, Kolter. Show the scalar tanh implicit equation and the expanded dz/dx quotient, plus a finite truncated chain I+J+J**2 as members, without naming the infinite-sum / inverse identification.
notes: SciML role: Deep Equilibrium Models and implicit layers; constant-memory reverse-mode through a root. Catalog: G0001 = tanh(w*z+x)-z; G0002 = sech**2 / (1-w*sech**2); G0003 = truncated I+J+J**2. F = (I - D_z f)^{-1}. SymPy: -g_x/g_z matches the sech formula.
